'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Operation Prosperity Guardian]]
***[[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] and [[Royal Navy]] warships in the [[Red Sea]] shoot down 21 suicide drones and [[missile]]s launched by [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] forces in [[Yemen]]. [[Secretary of State for Defence|British Defence Secretary]] [[Grant Shapps]] describes it as the largest attack in the area by the Houthis to date. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-uk-forces-shoot-down-houthi-missile-drone-attack-red-sea-us-military-2024-01-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 conflict in Ecuador]]
**President of Ecuador [[Daniel Noboa]] declares a [[state of emergency]] following the escape of [[José Adolfo Macías Villamar]], leader of the [[Los Choneros]] drug cartel, from prison. Gangsters subsequently storm a [[TC Televisión]] newsroom in [[Guayaquil]] and launch a series of riots, kidnappings, and explosions across the country. Eight civilians are killed, including two at {{interlanguage link|Centro Comercial Albán Borja|es}}, and three more injured during random shootings in Guayaquil, while two police officers are killed in [[Nobol]]. As a result, schools are closed and the military is called to stop gang activities. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/10/ten-killed-gangs-unleash-terror-as-ecuador-declares-state-of-emergency (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Three Hezbollah militants and [[Ali Hussein Barji]], the commander of [[Hezbollah Air Force|Hezbollah's air force]] at al-Tawil's funeral in [[Khirbet Selm]], [[southern Lebanon]] is assassinated by an Israeli strike although Hezbollah denies this claim. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/jan/09/hezbollah-drone-strike-hits-key-israeli-command-centre-safed (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanons-hezbollah-denies-israels-claim-killing-senior-hezbollah-commander-2024-01-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[South Korea]] bans the breeding and slaughter of [[dog meat|dogs for consumption]], effective in 2027. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/01/09/asia/south-korea-bill-bans-dog-meat-bill-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Federal prosecution of Donald Trump (election obstruction case)|Federal prosecution of Donald Trump]]
**A panel of three federal [[appellate judge]]s for the [[U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit]] hears oral arguments regarding the issue of [[presidential immunity]] for former US president [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-court-hearing-immunity-01-09-24 (CNN)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Russia]] places exiled tycoon [[Mikhail Khodorkovsky]] on a [[wanted list]] over comments he made regarding the ongoing war. [https://apnews.com/article/mikhail-khodorkovsky-russia-putin-b59a782cf1802c0f37c7bb9a0c98139a (AP)]
